name: openspec_instructions
description: Fetch enriched generation instructions for one OpenSpec artifact (openspec instructions <artifact> --json): template, instruction text, rules, resolved output path.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repo containing the OpenSpec change.

artifact.description: Artifact id to generate instructions for (e.g. proposal, design, specs, tasks).

changeName.description: OpenSpec change id the artifact belongs to (openspec instructions <artifact> --change <changeName> --json).
The OpenSpec change id this artifact belongs to.

artifactId.description: The artifact id these instructions were generated for.

schemaName.description: Name of the OpenSpec schema the change was created under.

changeDir.description: Absolute path to the change's directory.

outputPath.description: Artifact's output path relative to the change directory.

resolvedOutputPath.description: Absolute path the generated artifact file must be written to.

existingOutputPaths.description: Absolute paths of this artifact's output file(s) that already exist on disk.

description.description: Short description of the artifact, from the schema.

instruction.description: The generation instruction text the agent must follow to write the artifact.

context.description: Optional project-level background context injected from openspec/config.yaml, when configured.

rules.description: Extra rules for this artifact configured in openspec/config.yaml (e.g. the tasks file-disjoint independence rule); absent when none are configured.

template.description: Template structure the agent must fill in when writing the artifact file.

dependencies.description: Artifacts this one depends on, with their completion state.

done.description: Whether the dependency artifact is already complete.

unlocks.description: Artifact ids that become ready once this artifact is completed.

planningHome.description: Summary of the resolved OpenSpec planning home, as returned by the OpenSpec CLI.

root.description: Resolved OpenSpec root descriptor, as returned by the OpenSpec CLI.
